subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu support a user-facing inbound attachment-context opt-out such as `ignoreFileContent`, or should existing `mediaMaxMb` and session controls remain the supported behavior?
rationale: Current source and docs do not define this key, and adding it changes Feishu plugin configuration plus media-ingestion defaults in a user-visible way.

options.title: Add Feishu opt-out
options.body: Implement a Feishu-owned config field that skips inbound media download/context attachment while preserving a file placeholder.

options.title: Document existing controls
options.body: Decline the new setting and document that Feishu inbound media is controlled by `mediaMaxMb` and session practices.

options.title: Design generic channel policy
options.body: Pause this issue until maintainers choose a cross-channel inbound attachment policy instead of a Feishu-only knob.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu opt-out
recommendation.body: Implement a Feishu-owned config field that skips inbound media download/context attachment while preserving a file placeholder.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu plugin owner, and the unresolved question is Feishu-specific product/config policy.
